Brunch and Dinner with Santa Claus in Berks County 2026

Posted byZach Brown
November 6, 2026November 6, 2026 — Leave a Comment

Updated November 6, 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:04
Instaread

Family-friendly restaurants are never in short supply in Berks County. But the holiday season brings Santa and even more family fun around the breakfast or dinner table. See our list of restaurants offering dining with Santa this holiday season: 

Sunday, December 6

Doc & Bubba’s
Mohnton
December 6 & 20 | 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM

Doc & Bubba’s is hosting two brunches with Santa on Sunday, December 6 and Sunday, December 20. Brunch runs from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. with Santa arriving at 11:30 a.m. Music and carolling will be led by Erich Cawalla. Santa will make a bonus appearance on Monday, December 14 from 5:30 to 7:30 p.m. for pet photos during Paws and Pizza with Santa.

Sunday, December 13

Folino Estate Winery
Kutztown
December 13 | 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM

Babbo Natale is arriving at Folino Estate Winery on Sunday, December 13. Reservations are available from 10 a.m. until 3 p.m. for a family-friendly brunch. The cost is $78 for adults and $30 for children ages 5-12.
